summary: A Depth subscription: a depth packet replaces the whole book, so bids the exchange removed are gone and only the one ask left shows (audit P-04); a touch line after it moves the price over the same book.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; the web's Kotak adapter puts no mode in data.
The desktop sends OI as both oi and open_interest for every broker, as the recorded Zerodha transcript does; the web's Kotak adapter sends oi only.
The web sends the packet's own net change percent (nc) as percent_change for every scrip; the desktop's carrier keeps a change only for an index, so an equity or a derivative frame has none.
The web's Kotak depth frame also names the book total totalbuyqty; the desktop's Kotak dialect does not send that name.
The web's Kotak depth frame also names the book total totalsellqty; the desktop's Kotak dialect does not send that name.

A market picture's total is the exchange's figure now: with every bid gone it is 0. The desktop folds a 0 total as 'unchanged' (streaming::State::fold_picture keep_i) and sends the last nonzero total, 9000, over an empty bid side; the web sends 0.
deviations.ref: kotak/streaming/mod.rs fold_picture; kotak_adapter.py:476 (a complete packet's fields win)
